title: lunarsim-earth-link-samples v2
description: Hourly direct-to-Earth windows at points about 100 m apart along every rover route of a terrain pack, for every lighting route of routes-v1.json (writer tools/comms/earth_link.py samples2, B-52; reader lunarsim/comms.py EarthLink.load_samples, whose validate_samples() also checks that every series decodes inside the time axis and every route runs from its first site's sample to its last). Version 2 is the v1 file (samples, series and legs unchanged) with the lighting routes appended; the -lite variant keeps the first criterion only. Windows: [s0, l0, g1, l1, ...] hour indices, start0 = s0, end0 = start0 + l0 (exclusive), start1 = end0 + g1.

xy_m.description: terrain pack local frame (m); route samples sit on 20 m post centres

id.description: site or pad id for a leg's end point, null for a route sample

mast_los.description: line of sight to the 10 m mast at BASE within 10 km

routes.description: routes[leg][lighting]: sample ids along the routes-v1.json route, in route order, end points included; [] when the leg has no route in that lighting
